annotation.title_clean: 国务院关于印发《河套深港科技创新合作区深圳园区发展规划》的通知
annotation.title_en: State Council Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the Shenzhen Park of the Hetao Shenzhen-Hong Kong Science and Technology Innovation Cooperation Zone
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院 (State Council of the People's Republic of China)
annotation.summary_en: State Council development plan (2023) for the Shenzhen park of the Hetao Shenzhen-Hong Kong science and technology cooperation zone, setting goals to 2025 and 2035. Mainly innovation, customs, tax and cross-border data policy, with passing provisions on AI standards, robot testing and certification platforms, medical robots and driverless buses.
key_provisions_or_claims: Builds a special customs supervision zone with a 'white list' system and first-line/second-line management.
Sets up robot testing and certification public service platforms and pushes development of related technical standards.
Develops medical robots and an AI open innovation platform, with an unmanned factory demonstration base.
Creates a fully driverless intelligent connected bus demonstration area and pilots in smart manufacturing and healthcare.
Sets up cross-border data channels, 15% preferential corporate tax and Hong Kong-aligned research rules.
